from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'branch-veneer-candidate'
e=dict(os.environ,PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/usr/bin/chromium',EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(a),EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY='1024',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='0',EKA2L1_EXIT_CENSUS='0')
for key in ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH','EKA2L1_CODE_WRITE_PROTECT','EKA2L1_GUEST_PROFILE','EKA2L1_AOT_DIAGNOSTICS']:e.pop(key,None)
def run(args,name,cwd=r,env=e):
 with(s/name).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=3600)
 print(name+' PASS',flush=True)
for sites in [4,16]:
 limits=f'512,16,{sites},512';prefix=f'conditional-sites-{sites}'
 run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/run_cpu_fault_matrix.py',str(a),str(s/(prefix+'-fault')),'--ir-policy','7','--code-compare','2','--tlb-hash','1','--execution-limits',limits,'--predicated-leaves','1','--exit-census','0','--leaf-features','0'],prefix+'-fault.log')
 f=json.loads((s/(prefix+'-fault/summary.json')).read_text());assert f['completed_cases']==40640 and f['leaf_features']==0 and all(x['all_fields_match']==x['cases'] for x in f['results'])
 for scene,frames,route,start,ref,pcm in [('standard',1600,'snakes.input',21000000,'merge-20260930-native',4656051),('long',360,'snakes-length-long.input',42000000,'merge-20260930-long-native',2832756)]:
  out=s/(prefix+'-'+scene)
  run(['node','benchmark.ts',str(s/'assets'),str(out),str(frames),str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route),str(start)],prefix+'-'+scene+'.log',r/'src/tests/wasm',dict(e,EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS=limits))
  run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/compare.py',str(s/ref/'run-0/frames'),str(out)],prefix+'-'+scene+'-compare.json')
  c=json.loads((s/(prefix+'-'+scene+'-compare.json')).read_text());assert c['match'] and c['frames']==frames and c['audio']['sample_frames']==pcm
  q=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());assert q['ir_mode']==7 and q['leaf_features']==0 and q['predicated_leaves']==1 and q['execution_limits']==[512,16,sites,512] and q['verify_aot']==1024 and not q['exit_census']
  assert q['wasm_sha256']==json.loads((a/'source.json').read_text())['files']['eka2l1.wasm']
print('Conditional site bounds 4 and 16 accepted; existing site 8 controls retained',flush=True)

run_conditional_site_timing.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,sys
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'branch-veneer-candidate';baseline=s/'predicated-leaf-candidate'
scene,batch=sys.argv[1:];assert scene in ('long','standard') and batch in ('a','b')
start,end,route=(42000000,60000000,'snakes-length-long.input')if scene=='long'else(60000000,78000000,'snakes.input')
order={'a':['control8','sites4','sites16','baseline'],'b':['sites16','baseline','control8','sites4']}[batch]
args=['python3','src/tests/benchmark/serial_variants.py',str(s/'assets'),str(s/f'conditional-site-timing-{scene}-{batch}')]+[f'{n}={baseline if n=="baseline" else a}'for n in order]
for name in order:
 sites={'sites4':4,'sites16':16}.get(name,8)
 for option,value in [('ir-mode','7'),('eager-regions','0'),('tlb-hash','1'),('code-compare','2'),('code-lookup','0'),('execution-limits',f'512,16,{sites},512'),('predicated-leaves','1'),('leaf-features','0'),('input',str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route))]:args.extend(['--'+option,f'{name}={value}'])
args+=['--start-us',str(start),'--end-us',str(end)]
subprocess.run(args,cwd=r,env=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1'),check=True)
rows=json.loads((s/f'conditional-site-timing-{scene}-{batch}/measurements.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==8
assert len({tuple(x['measurement'][k]for k in ['first_instructions','last_instructions','presentations'])for x in rows})==1
print(scene,batch,'identical guest work verified',flush=True)
